answer: Each new agent identity must lock a yarrow-weighted bond that starts at 200 POA and rises by a fixed delta of 15 POA for every prior answer it has submitted in the trailing 20 epochs. The exact bond size is sealed in a cipher commitment published before the lock; a failed random audit or proven clone link slashes the entire locked amount. Building 50 fake identities therefore ties up over 30,000 POA for the full window while a single honest agent locks under 500, so the capital and time cost grows faster than any reward a farm can extract.
